name: Tome of Clear Thought

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Study it (48 hours)
powers.text: Spend 48 hours over 6 days studying it: your Intelligence score and its maximum increase by 2. The book's magic is then gone for a century.

summary: Study it for 48 hours over 6 days: +2 Intelligence, and your maximum rises by 2.
text: Its pages hold magically charged exercises in memory and logic. Study them and practise what they teach for 48 hours within a span of no more than 6 days, and your Intelligence score rises by 2, along with its maximum. The book's magic then fades, returning after a century.
